intro: Mysterio is built for everyday living that still feels special. With its patterned Lidya top and sturdy frame, it turns family meals into effortless gatherings filled with warmth and ease.

features.title: Sized for family dining
features.text: Comfortably seats six, giving families and small groups space to connect over daily meals or weekend spreads.

features.title: Lidya patterned tabletop
features.text: Distinctive high-gloss design adds texture and visual depth, elevating the look of your dining space with ease.

features.title: Durable metal understructure
features.text: Powder-coated metal frame supports the table steadily, balancing strength with a sleek, modern profile.

features.title: Easy-care glossy finish
features.text: Resists scratches and spills, keeping the table fresh and inviting even with daily family use.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
